title: Non-blocking follow-up from PR #152 review (frontend-support-resistance-overlay)
description: Tracked non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #152 (frontend-support-resistance-overlay), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges. Distinct from the PR's own blocking findings (the zone-band price-scale autoscale distortion, and the single-visible-bar setData crash risk), which stay on frontend-support-resistance-overlay itself and must be fixed before that PR can be accepted.

checklist.step: supportResistanceZoneHelp/falseBreakoutHelp's interpretValue functions (metricHelpContent.ts) read from the full (up to 15) zones array passed in from PriceChart.tsx, not the MAX_DISPLAYED_ZONES=6-capped, currently-visible-date-range-windowed subset the chart actually draws (buildZoneRenderData/buildFalseBreakoutMarkers apply that capping/windowing, but the two MetricHelp call sites pass the unfiltered `zones` array straight through). The legend balloon can therefore describe a 'nearest zone' or 'most recent false breakout' that has no corresponding shaded band/marker/price-line anywhere on the visible chart, which is confusing on its own. Fix direction: pass the same capped/windowed subset (or at least filter by the same MAX_DISPLAYED_ZONES slice, and for falseBreakoutHelp also the current visible date range) into interpretValue that the chart-drawing effects use.
